sources.title: Regulations Governing the EuroLeague Women 2026-2027
sources.sourceLocation: Official EuroLeague Women 2026-27 downloads: EuroLeague Women Regulations 2026-27
sources.license: Official copyrighted publication; used only as a reference authority and not reproduced
sources.status: Current EuroLeague Women authority for competition administration, participation, calendar, competition system, player eligibility, Final Six, finances, court layout, media, game-day obligations, commissioner use, and three-referee operation.

sources.title: Regulations for European Club Competitions 2026-2027
sources.sourceLocation: Official FIBA Europe / EuroLeague Women 2026-27 downloads
sources.license: Official copyrighted publication; used only as a reference authority and not reproduced
sources.status: Controls club registration, forms, facilities, eligibility administration, discipline, protests, game operations, advertising, security, media, and other general requirements except where the EuroLeague Women regulations specifically control.

sources.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2024 v1.0
sources.type: Current-effective international playing-rules foundation before October 1, 2026
sources.sourceLocation: Uploaded FIBA Rulebook reference and official FIBA Resource Hub
sources.license: Official copyrighted publication; used only as a reference authority and not reproduced
sources.status: Current rules authority through September 30, 2026. Course content labels these provisions current only until the 2026 edition becomes effective.

sources.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules Interpretations 2024 v1.0
sources.status: Controls official interpretations used before the 2026 interpretation set becomes effective or is otherwise formally adopted.

sources.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2026 v1.1
sources.type: Published future-effective rules at the date of course production and expected 2026-27 playing-rules authority
sources.status: Becomes effective worldwide October 1, 2026. Because the EuroLeague Women regular season begins after that date, the 2026 rules are expected to govern 2026-27 play unless an authorized FIBA Europe directive states otherwise. The platform must switch status on the effective date.

sources.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2026 Changes v1.1
sources.status: Transition source for new terminology, technical-foul categories, disruptive and flagrant foul administration, signals, scoresheet markings, replay situations, and other 2026 changes. Do not apply before October 1, 2026.

sources.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2026 — Basketball Equipment v1.0
sources.status: Controls Level 1 court, backboard, lighting, timing, shot-clock, ball, and equipment standards beginning October 1, 2026, subject to EuroLeague Women court-layout and event requirements.

sources.title: FIBA Internal Regulations — Book 3, Players and Officials
sources.type: Official game-official licensing, duties, nominations, commissioner, and participant authority
sources.sourceLocation: Official FIBA statutes and regulations resources
sources.status: Controls FIBA referee and commissioner duties, licensing, conduct, nominations, uniforms, reporting, protests, and professional obligations.

sources.title: FIBA Game Officials Licensing 2025-2027 Guidelines
sources.sourceLocation: Official FIBA Game Officials Licensing resources
sources.status: Provides the current licensing-cycle framework. It does not guarantee a learner a licence, nomination, appointment, or professional assignment.

sources.title: Authorized FIBA Three-Person Officiating, iRef, Fitness, and Referee Development Resources
sources.type: Official or authorized mechanics and development material
sources.sourceLocation: FIBA Refereeing, iRef, FIBA Europe referee-development, technical-clinic, and assignment materials when authorized
sources.status: Used for mechanics, court coverage, rotations, fitness, communication, evaluation, and professional-development instruction. Restricted resources require authorized access and qualified review.

sources.title: EuroLeague Women 2026-27 Event and Assignment Directives
sources.publisher: FIBA Europe and authorized competition officials
sources.type: Assignment-, venue-, and event-specific controlling authority
sources.sourceLocation: Appointment communication, technical meeting, commissioner instructions, venue operations, broadcast rundown, security plan, IRS test, Final Six instructions, and postgame reporting channels
sources.status: Controls game-specific arrival, crew contact, uniforms, table meeting, replay check, court and advertising layout, presentation, media timing, security, reporting, travel, and any authorized modification.

sources.title: FIBA Europe Women in Basketball and Women’s Basketball Summit Referee Development Resources
sources.type: Official professional-development, inclusion, leadership, and mentoring context
sources.sourceLocation: Official FIBA Europe Women in Basketball programs and Women’s Basketball Summit resources
sources.status: Supports leadership, mentoring, career development, inclusion, and institutional-development lessons. It is not a substitute for playing rules, competition regulations, mechanics, or assignment directives.
